title:
This epic updates the `topContributingFeatures` field based on the failure modes that are selected in the
'Reliability.ResidualDiagnosticsAlertDetailFilterPanel'.

It listens for `SINGLE_INPUT_CHANGE` and checks for the `failureModes` input.
If the action is not from `fromPlotFeature` or if the `disableEpic` is set to true, the epic will return an empty action.
If the `failureModes` input is present, it fetches the failure modes and updates the `topContributingFeatures` and sets `disableEpic` to true,
to prevent this epic from being triggered again.
If the `plot` field in the payload is set to true, then it emits `FILTER_SUBMIT` action.
name: UpdateFeaturesFromFailureModesEpic
